Aisha (CS Ops): Quick heads up — planning to flip HealthScore v2 to prod tomorrow 09:00 PT. v2 pulls in enablement_survey_score and will suppress accounts where privacy_opt_out = true. Need ops signoff on playbook behavior when scores change because signals are gated. @Tom can you confirm dedupe/aggregation safety? @Priya want to align enablement nudges. :eyes:

Tom (Data Eng): ran a full staging sweep, no panics. Aggregation uses last_known_score as a fallback for gated signals so we don't emit nulls. Backfill plan attached; simple example SQL for fallback:```sql
UPDATE healthscores
SET score_v2 = COALESCE(score_components.enablement, last_known_score)
WHERE privacy_opt_out = true;
```
Will also emit a delta metric so we can watch churn.

Priya (Enablement): Thanks — agree we should NOT send enablement nudges to contacts flagged privacy_opt_out. Proposed playbook change: gate all enablement-driven actions with `consent_flags.enablement = true`. Example rule snippet: `if health_score < 40 && consent_flags.enablement then trigger_enablement_sequence()`

Marco (CS Manager): scheduling a 30m dry-run at 08:30 tomorrow to sample ~5k accounts and validate playbook decisions. @Aisha can you own runbook + rollback? Also request a quick list of accounts that flip from green->yellow purely due to privacy gating so managers can review.

Nina (Legal): quick ask — ensure the survey opt-out mapping matches what legal has for marketing vs enablement. If enablement uses different consent, we need to document. I can sign off after a one-page mapping.

deploy-bot: staging deployment complete — HealthScore v2 staged at https://staging.redwood/healthscore/v2 (build 2024.11.3).

Aisha (CS Ops): I will draft the runbook now and add telemetry dashboards: `healthscore_v2_impact`, `playbook_enablement_suppressed_count`, and `enablement_nudge_optoout_blocked`. Putting a 2-hour monitoring window post-flip and manual rollback steps.

Tom (Data Eng): adding a short alert: if >5% of active accounts rely solely on enablement signal and get fallback, page infra, we investigate.

Priya (Enablement): ok from product side — will pause any campaign triggers tied to the old score for 48h post-rollout to let us inspect signal noise. :thumbsup:

Marco (CS Manager): great. please ping #oncall-cs when ready to flip. Thanks everyone.
